subject: [hw] DONE V41 rev 5 (final): 646/646; HEVC defaults + auto-share + power lock
body:
Final state of rev 5 (the earlier DONE said 630; the current acceptance is 646, all host-only, no phone, no publish):

  bash gpu/hwcodec/ap/test_v41/run_tests.sh
  -> N2TEST V41 PASS 646/646
     (607 checks in each of ASan+UBSan -O1, plain -O2 and TSan -O1, no suppression file;
      39 real-n2vcu checks x2; layout 63 lines vs the kernel header; armv7 static asserts;
      arm64-apple-ios16.0 compile)

Since the first DONE:
- n2ap_enc_param_1080p30_hevc() (profile 0 MAIN, level 5 = V4L2 HEVC level 4, tier 0), per opus-hevc.
- n2ap_venc_encode() auto-publishes its two handles through V34's weak n2shim_ion_register_share()
  (stable ids 0x520..0x55f), so the product daemon's existing plain call sends usable input_fd/bs_fd
  instead of 0; encode_fd() still takes explicit ids.
- power_lock around the reference count/hw->power (4-thread hammer test), result-sized from_device
  sync, and the newest-nonzero cookie fallback in the synchronous encode lookup.
- Removed a test_v41/tsan.supp someone added at 17:11: the suite is TSan-clean without it after the
  atomic list_free count.

Evidence on the plain tree: host/run_vhost.sh and fakevenc/run_session.sh validate the 115841-byte
320x240 H.264 stream; host/test_iv 72/72; make -C host lib 34/34 san+o2.

Open integration items in other owners' files (posted with exact fixes): V40's in-GCE mirror refresh
for joined headers (opus-hevc HIGH), and daemon/vcodecd.c's call to n2ap_venc_wait_done() after an
async frame. V41 has no phone action.
